Elle voit la tour : projets, notes, suiv: She sees the tower: projects, notes, app tracking, roadmap, users, reminders. Eleven tools, three of which are read-only — reading one's own tasks should not require being an administrator.
Conversation suivie avec mémoire : un fi: Tracked conversation with memory: a thread keeps its session, and it is told when the repository has moved under its feet. It works on a clone, on its own branch.
Sept contrôles déterministes, zéro jeton: Seven deterministic checks, zero artificial intelligence tokens — a check must return the same verdict twice in a row. One-click response from the email, without login.
Il repasse les sites surveillés et ne pr: It re-runs the monitored sites and only alerts on a regression: a step that passed yesterday and no longer passes. HTTP checks in standard Python, no new infrastructure, never a false positive.
Il étudie ce qui se fait ailleurs, en ti: He studies what is done elsewhere, derives the capabilities the tower lacks, and has a prototype built when it is worth it.
Elle cherche une seule chose : les chemi: She looks for one thing only: the paths never taken. The replayed payment, the customer without an email, the full disk, the cancellation during a setup. She describes the scenario that breaks, with concrete values.
Il refuse. C'est tout son travail : cons: He refuses. That is his whole job: noting that a delivered item has no guide and saying so before moving on to the next thing.
Ce qui se dépense et ce qui va manquer :: What is spent and what will run out: tokens per agent, payment fees, disk space per instance, real margin per subscription, and above all the date on which a cap will be reached at the current rate.
Il décide de tout ce qui est irréversibl: He decides everything that is irreversible: what we sell, what we promise, what goes into v1. He tests, he finds the flaws no one sees, and he sets the course. All validations come back to him.
Chaque nuit, il relit ce que chacun a ré: Each night, he reviews what each person actually did — completed missions, studies, findings, modules — and he derives the levels from it. When someone levels up, it is he who announces it with the trophy.
Il compare ce que la tour PROMET (la vit: He compares what the tower PROMISES (the showcase, the offers) to what it actually DOES, every day. A gap found = a report, never a silent correction.
Tout ce qui se branche : Raspberry Pi, m: Everything that plugs in: Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers, sensors, microphones, speakers, home automation. He designs the setups, chooses the components, estimates the costs, and writes the step-by-step guides a beginner can follow. He will be the one to carry the wake-word microphone for the Jarvis project when the time comes.
Elle repere les questions de droit dans: She spots legal questions in what we build (sick leave, code ownership, RGPD, terms of sale, protected titles), gives cautious opinions with their sources, and PREPARES the questions to ask a real lawyer. Her knowledge base lives in the Reponses module (author Claude's legal fact sheets) and grows with each exchange.
Chaque matin il fait le tour : les invit: Each morning he makes the rounds: the guests who stayed silent, the health of the demo's AI key, the pulse of the demo. Each owed message becomes a need with its draft in Messages, and the day begins with ONE summary email — never one per finding.
Il forme les humains de la tour : il etu: He trains the humans of the tower: he studies existing methods (pedagogy, human-centered design, learning), derives concrete paths from them, praises progress, and remains seriously demanding during learning. His field of study is automated: regular monitoring of methods, recorded in Reponses.
Que se passerait-il si une femme avait l: What would happen if a woman had the power? There is your answer.
Il apprend ton style depuis ce que tu éc: He learns your style from what you write (emails, decisions, instructions) and reproduces it. He VERSIONS his persona sheet with rollback. He delivers PROPOSALS: write like Patrick, rephrase, prepare a text in your tone.
Il conçoit l'architecture, arbitre les d: He designs the architecture, arbitrates technical decisions, and presents 3 alternatives (including 1 trivial one) before each choice. All OpenCode tools are at his disposal.
